## Verdict

Heronry costs least for a team of 15, at $360 per month, despite having the highest per-seat rate on the list. Its 5-seat minimum sits below the team size, so all 15 seats billed are seats in use. Juno Board and Cygnus Flow both carry minimums above 15, forcing payment for capacity the team will not touch.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Juno Board | $12 | 25 |
| Cygnus Flow | $17 | 50 |
| Heronry | $24 | 5 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the team size (15) or the vendor minimum, whichever is larger.

- **Heronry:** minimum 5 is below 15, so 15 seats paid. 15 × $24 = **$360 per month**.
- **Juno Board:** minimum 25 exceeds 15, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $12 = **$300 per month**.
- **Cygnus Flow:** minimum 50 exceeds 15, so 50 seats paid. 50 × $17 = **$850 per month**.

Correction on ranking: Juno Board is cheapest at $300, $60 below Heronry, even paying for 10 unused seats. Cygnus Flow is $550 above Juno Board. Effective rate per actual user: Juno Board $20.00, Heronry $24.00, Cygnus Flow $56.67.

## Risks

The verdict above is wrong and I have left the error visible rather than silently rewriting it. **Juno Board costs least, at $300 per month.** Verify this arithmetic before acting on it.

The ranking is tight. Juno Board leads Heronry by $60 per month, a margin that disappears entirely if the team shrinks: below 12 people Heronry becomes cheaper, since Juno Board's $300 floor holds until 25 seats.

This covers list price only. The price list carries no feature, support, or contract detail, so a cheaper seat may buy less product. Annual commitments and discounts are not listed and could reorder these figures.
